text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Project Overview Document quote states 'Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000', matching the claim."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown passage states the Finance Committee revision in December 2026 adjusted the total to $2,600,000."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Both inputs ($2,600,000 and $2,400,000) appear in the cited evidence and 2,600,000 - 2,400,000 = 200,000."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Team & Governance Document states budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"A neutral label with no factual assertion."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED","reason":"The documents state the Finance Committee made the revision ('Following a revision by the Finance Committee'), so the absence claim is contradicted or at least not cleanly true; it is also not a bare statement of nothing being stated."}]}
